prompt: State what is meant by a homogeneous equation with respect to SI base units.

mark_scheme.criterion: Every term (on both sides and separated by addition or subtraction) has the same SI base units.

hints: Focus on the units of each individual term in the equation.
Mention both sides of the equation and any terms added or subtracted.
solution: An equation is homogeneous when every term joined by addition or subtraction, as well as both sides of the equation, has the same SI base units.
teacher_walkthrough: State clearly that all additive/subtractive terms must have identical base units.
Mention that the left-hand side and right-hand side must have matching base units.

provenance.independence_statement: Original 1-mark recall drill testing definition of homogeneity.
